title: Eggs carried in a mouth
hook: Fish care for eggs in more than one way.

knows: Different fish can have different structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The second schematic places the dots inside the fish’s mouth to represent carried eggs. Some fishes mouthbrood eggs or young, offering them a protected place; the number of dots is illustrative and not all fishes use this strategy.

misconception: The first imagined explanation must apply to this fish.
objective: In mouthbrooding fishes, where can a parent carry eggs or young?
